title: Beyond Skinwalker investigation at Bradshaw Ranch
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Beyond Skinwalker investigation at Bradshaw Ranch, about Beyond Skinwalker seasons at Bradshaw Ranch, Sedona, Arizona, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I went there myself and there were some strange things that came up on the cameras.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a guest presented as the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property famous for reports of strange events, talks about Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona, Arizona, which was investigated for a series called Beyond Skinwalker. He says he went there himself and that some strange things showed up on the cameras, and he mentions people named Dr. Taylor and Eric Bart in connection with the work. If true, it would suggest the odd activity is not tied to just one place.
